limitations: Same simulator-generated expert demonstrations exported through the official LeRobot SDK; not an independent external or human demonstration dataset.
SDK rows are read once into resident CPU tensors; this is not native LeRobot per-minibatch loader throughput.
Offline input was already prepared. Collection/export cost is excluded from the data-ready run; timing is not acquisition-inclusive or a controlled ODS speed comparison.
One training seed and four demonstrations; no statistical training-efficiency claim.
Periodic and repeated training-reset panels are fitting/repeatability diagnostics, not unseen-state generalization.
No reserved final100 or formal32/160 efficiency sweep was performed.
Exact recurrent minibatch equality is unverified despite empirically identical saved model tensors.
